trigger: Email, website RFQ or chat arrives
inputs: Original message; attachments; contact; airport; required-by time
outputs: Owned case; acknowledgement; AOG priority and duty owner
control: Acknowledge within 5 minutes during staffed cover (target, unmeasured); escalation must have a named backup.

inputs: PN as supplied; manufacturer; qty/UOM; aircraft context; condition; cert requirement
outputs: Confirmed requirement lines; unresolved ambiguities and approved alternate evidence
control: Keep raw PN and normalised search key; never erase dash/suffix meaning or accept an alternate from string similarity.

stage: Find supply and fan out RFQs
inputs: Owned-stock view; approved supplier list; authorised locator results
outputs: Supplier RFQs; timestamped offers; price/availability/cert comparison
control: Human chooses recipients; preserve source/listing age and avoid leaking one supplier’s terms to another.

inputs: Original CoC/release PDFs; issuer; PN/SN/lot; ownership/provenance; customer acceptance requirements
outputs: Reviewed dossier or named quality hold; expiry/review decisions
control: A readable form is not authentic evidence; valid release is not installation approval.

stage: Price and issue a customer quote
trigger: Offer and delivery route are credible
inputs: Confirmed supply; currency; freight/tax assumptions; core liability; margin policy
outputs: Versioned quote, validity, conditions, delivery basis, approval record
control: Quote does not silently clear outstanding quality/export/credit holds.

stage: Accept order and clear commercial/export holds
inputs: Accepted quote revision; legal buyer/end user; destination; classification evidence; credit/payment
outputs: Sales order and linked PO; authorised decisions or shipment hold
control: Sanctions matching is one check, not a complete EAR/ITAR/UK export determination.

inputs: Purchase order; expected unit/lot; delivery and certificate terms
outputs: Reservation/receipt; accepted physical identity; quarantine or discrepancy

pain.quote: Parts and inventory are very difficult

control: Catalogue listing, supplier promise, physical receipt and released stock are different states.

inputs: Released item; packing/doc set; named consignee/handler; carrier confirmation
control: AOG priority cannot override physical safety, dangerous-goods or export checks.

inputs: Order and receipt; invoice; bank/payment/FX facts; payroll/admin calendar
outputs: Matched ledger entry; receivable/payable; discrepancy task; month-end export
control: Keep statutory accounting/payroll authority in the current package until local requirements and reconciliation tests pass.

trigger: Return request, core due date or audit query
inputs: Original serial/lot and sale; return terms; repairer disposition; evidence history
outputs: RMA/core credit; stock disposition; customer resolution; auditable closed case

pain.quote: Inventory and maintenance tracking are completely separate.

control: A returned item never becomes saleable through a stock-count correction alone.
